marbles.caption: Time runs in frames. A circle is an emission, with its letter; a bar is completion; a cross is an error. A lane that ends in a small hollow ring is where the operator stopped listening to that stream, and what it would have delivered afterwards is not drawn.
marbles.opening: The drawing opens at the end of the run, and an output lane shows only what has been emitted by the selected frame: step back, or press Play where it is offered, to watch each output value arrive from the emission it comes from.

legend.inner: Grey · a stream the operator opened

flow.caption: A token is a message, with its letter: green while it moves at the selected step, outlined while a node holds it. A node a message leaves or reaches at the step is outlined in green, and the words inside a node say what it holds or decides. Step forward to move the messages on.
flow.diagram: Each frame of the diagram is the same step of the flow, and switching between the two keeps the moment; an output lane shows only what has been emitted by the selected frame.

legend.subject: Bold name · the part the pattern names
legend.other: Grey outline · the endpoints around it; a tinted pipe is a channel
legend.actual: Green · a message moving at this step, and the nodes it leaves or reaches
legend.muted: Outlined · a message a node is holding

states.caption: Each row is one object and each column a state it can be in; a token sits in the column of its object's state. A token is green while it moves at the selected step, with an arrow from the state it left and the operation that moved it, and the column its move ends in is tinted; it is outlined while it stays where it is. A dashed ring is where an object left the example. The words under a name say what that object holds. Step forward to move the example on.

legend.subject: Bold name · a state the pattern adds
legend.actual: Green · an object moving at this step, and the way it takes
legend.muted: Outlined · an object staying where it is
